title: Internal Tools
meta: A simple internal tool that replaces spreadsheets and manual copy-paste for your team. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Internal tools that replace spreadsheets and manual steps
overview: If your team runs on spreadsheets, shared inboxes and copy-paste, we turn the biggest pain into a proper tool. We watch how the work is done today, then build forms, tables, search and approvals that do the same job with fewer mistakes. Staff sign in with their own accounts and see only what they need. We import your existing sheet data on day one, so nothing is retyped.

pkgs.blurb: One spreadsheet process turned into a simple tool.
A fuller tool with roles, notifications and exports.
A connected team tool with dashboards, approvals and integrations.

faq: Can you use my existing spreadsheet data?
Yes. We import it on day one, tidy obvious errors such as duplicates and mixed date formats, and show you a summary of anything we could not match. Your original sheet stays untouched.
Does it need to be online?
It runs in the browser, so staff need an internet connection. For tools used in places with weak signal, ask about the progressive web app service, which adds offline use.
Small changes, such as a new field or status, are easy and we show you how to make some yourself. Larger changes can be a new order. We build in clear parts to keep changes cheap.
Is it safe to put staff data in?
We use secure sign-in, encrypted connections and limited roles, and we host it in your own cloud account. For very sensitive data, tell us in the form and we plan extra protection.
